text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That run worthy of being called a "Supercar"
was seriously the greatest!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Thanks for putting on such a fun show! Come back to Fukushima again, hear?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for cheering! The view from
the course is awesome, so I'll definitely come back!

Maruzensky delivered an outstanding result
in the race she entered during the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew, the sun's really gone down already, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I would've liked to stay a night,
but we're at training camp, so I guess it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, the race was so much fun~
Looks like the training camp's already paying off!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I do believe everyone had a wonderful time as well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Maruzen-san!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back! ...Wait, when on earth
did you go to Fukushima!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was watching the broadcast and saw someone familiar running,
and for a second I thought she had a twin!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If it was a nice surprise, then I'm glad~!
Well, it should've been on the racecard, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I completely overlooked it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, that was so exciting!
Everyone went wild the moment they crossed the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just watching got me so fired up
that I ended up training afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, really!?
choice_data_list: Seems like it gave you some good inspiration.
Seems like it gave you some good inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, all that hard running was totally worth it~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So Grass-chan and the others helped put together a celebration party!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, Trainer-san,
please tell me all kinds of stories about the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't that sweet of you~!
I'd love to participate!

And so, the race run during summer camp
yielded the best possible outcome and inspiration for everyone around.
